math.parser: math_verify.parse on one boxed wrapper around only the supplied extracted string
math.equivalence: Exact trimmed nonempty string equality, else both verify directions on parsed expressions
math.parse_failure: Retain nonempty raw string; identical trimmed raw answers may match; other comparisons unverifiable/incorrect
math.engine_errors: Pinned library default handling; parse failure recorded as math_raw; no custom semantic engine patches

mathvista.source: Adaptation of pinned official normalize_extracted_answer, default ignore_empty_extractions=False, preceded by required None/empty guard
mathvista.choice_output: First option letter for normalized choice text; duplicates preserved and equivalent text shares first letter
mathvista.reference_input: Known reference choice text is matched exactly before option-letter syntax; never run prediction-label parsing on a known reference choice text
mathvista.distance: Unicode unit-cost Levenshtein; distance ties use original choice order

specification.missing: None/empty extraction or failed MathVista normalization -> one NO_ANSWER group, always incorrect; never filtered out
specification.grouping: Revealed-order complete-link; join earliest group only if equivalent to every member; earliest supporting answer represents group; no unseen bridging
specification.self_consistency_ties: Earliest supporting rollout in current revealed order
specification.input_separation: Selectors receive question metadata without gold/reference fields; gold only supplied to grading/reference checks

library_edge_cases.interpretation: Recorded library convention, not independent proof of mathematical equivalence
Recorded library convention, not independent proof of mathematical equivalence

specification.limitations: Math-Verify normalization/structural conventions are benchmark-scoring conventions, not proof of mathematical equivalence. Symmetric checking does not remove every ambiguity.
